messages.content: 如何設計一個大教堂風格的天花板？

function.name: building_information_get_data
function.description: Retrieve information about a specific building or monument Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

building_name.description: The name of the building or monument.

info_requested.description: The specific information requested about the building or monument. For example, 'height', 'architect', etc.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "如何設計一個大教堂風格的天花板？" They want design guidance for a cathedral-style ceiling. We can provide architectural design tips: vaulted ceilings, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses, stained glass, frescoes, etc. Provide steps: conceptualization, structural analysis, materials, lighting, decoration, acoustics. Also mention typical features: high vaulted ceilings, ribbed vaults, pointed arches, buttresses, stained glass windows, frescoes, ornamental plaster, etc. Provide a design process: site analysis, concept, structural engineering, material selection, detailing, finishing, lighting, acoustics. Provide references to Gothic architecture. Provide suggestions for modern reinterpretation. Provide a step-by-step guide. Also mention safety, building codes, etc. Provide a summary. Also maybe ask clarifying questions? But likely they want a design guide. Provide in Chinese. Use bullet points. Provide diagrams? Can't. Provide textual description. Also mention typical dimensions: height, span, etc. Provide typical materials: stone, wood, metal, plaster. Provide decorative elements: tracery, gargoyles, etc. Provide acoustic considerations: sound diffusion, reverberation. Provide lighting: natural via windows, artificial via chandeliers. Provide structural support: ribs, buttresses, columns. Provide modern alternatives: steel frames, glass, composite. Provide cost considerations. Provide references to famous cathedrals: Notre-Dame, Cologne, Chartres. Provide design steps: concept, schematic, design development, construction documents. Provide a checklist. Provide a sample design: a vaulted ceiling with ribbed vaults, central nave, transept, apse, stained glass windows, frescoes. Provide suggestions for color palette: gold, blue, red. Provide suggestions for lighting: LED strips behind stained glass. Provide suggestions for acoustics: use of acoustic panels. Provide suggestions for maintenance. Provide a conclusion. Also ask if they need specific details like dimensions or materials. Provide a thorough answer.
